title: Light and Seeing
seo_title: Grade 1 Light and Seeing Worksheets: We Need Light to See
standard_text: Make observations to construct an evidence-based account that objects in darkness can be seen only when illuminated.
meta_desc: Free grade 1 science worksheets on light and seeing (NGSS 1-PS4-2): light sources, dark boxes and how light helps us see. 100 picture questions with answers.
key_sub: Light comes from a source and bounces off things into our eyes.
body_html:
How to think about it

Is there light? Then we can see.

  • No light: we see nothing.
  • Light sources make light: sun, lamp, fire.
  • Light bounces off things into our eyes.
Example

A toy is in a dark box. Can you see it?

There is no light.

Answer: no

Example

A flashlight shines in the box. Can you see the toy?

Light bounces off the toy.

Answer: yes

Common mistakes

  • Thinking eyes make light.
  • Thinking the moon makes its own light.
  • Thinking some animals see in total darkness.

faq.q: Why can't we see in the dark?
faq.a: We see things when light bounces off them into our eyes. With no light, nothing bounces.
Something that makes its own light, like the sun, a lamp, a flashlight, fire or a firefly.
No. The moon reflects light from the sun.
